recording_stored_metadata_check.name: recording_stored_metadata_check
recording_stored_metadata_check.value: "recording"."transfer_state" <> 'Stored' or ("recording"."r2_object_key" is not null and "recording"."size_bytes" is not null and "recording"."sha256" is not null and "recording"."stored_at" is not null)

recording_waveform_stored_metadata_check.name: recording_waveform_stored_metadata_check
recording_waveform_stored_metadata_check.value: "recording"."waveform_state" <> 'Stored' or ("recording"."waveform_object_key" is not null and "recording"."waveform_generated_at" is not null)

recording_mp3_stored_metadata_check.name: recording_mp3_stored_metadata_check
recording_mp3_stored_metadata_check.value: "recording"."mp3_state" <> 'Stored' or ("recording"."mp3_object_key" is not null and "recording"."mp3_size_bytes" is not null and "recording"."mp3_generated_at" is not null)

recording_transcript_skip_reason_check.name: recording_transcript_skip_reason_check
recording_transcript_skip_reason_check.value: ("recording"."transcript_state" is distinct from 'Skipped' and "recording"."transcript_skip_reason" is null) or ("recording"."transcript_state" = 'Skipped' and "recording"."transcript_skip_reason" is not null and "recording"."transcript_skip_reason" in ('analysis_disabled', 'spam_gate_not_passed', 'too_short'))

recording_transcript_usage_check.name: recording_transcript_usage_check
recording_transcript_usage_check.value: "recording"."transcript_state" is distinct from 'Completed' or ("recording"."transcript_audio_ms" >= 0 and "recording"."transcript_cost_usd" >= 0 and "recording"."transcript_completed_at" is not null)

report_job_completed_check.name: report_job_completed_check
report_job_completed_check.value: ("report_job"."status" = 'Completed') = ("report_job"."completed_at" is not null and "report_job"."artifacts_expire_at" is not null)
